text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Um... M-Meisho Doto, at your service...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Through running... if possible, um... 
I-I'd like to gain some confidence...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I know it's presumptuous of me! But 
someday, I want to like myself...! 
I-I-I'll do my b-best!

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
